Name: (AT) Shardust's Colorful and Pastel Craftables
Author: Shardust
Description:
[size=4][center][u][b][size=5]2025 UPDATE

NOW WITH MORE RECOLORED ITEMS, PLUS PASTEL VERSION
[/size]
[size=4]Requires SMAPI and Alternative Textures and was tested with the latest STABLE (at the
time of the upload) version of the game, SMAPI, and [size=4][u][b][size=4]Alternative Textures[/size][/b][/u][/size]. [/size][/b][/u][size=4]
[/size]
A port of my [size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5284](CP) Shardust's Colorful and Pastel Craftables - Also with Decor Options[/url]﻿﻿[/size] for Alternative Textures.
[size=4]
[b][u]The Decor options (and some items) were omitted [/u][/b][/size][b][u][size=4]due to AT's own framework limitations.[/size][/u][/b][/center]
[/size][center][size=4]Unlike CP, you can color each item individually; you can have, for example, a row of Amethyst Kegs for Ancient Wine, a row of Emerald Kegs for Green Tea, and a row of Umber Kegs for Coffee, at the same time.
[/size][size=4]
Colors available in the "Colorful" versions: Amethyst, Aquamarine, Ash, Blackberry, Coal, Cocoa, Cream, Diamond, Emerald, Goldenrod, Mahogany, Mocha, Oak, Olive, Ruby, Rust, Saffron, Sapphire, Spinel, Steel, Topaz, Umber, Walnut, Wine.

Colors available in the "Pastel" versions: Hazel, Honey, Lilac, Melon, Mint, Peach, Salt, Sugar.

Enjoy![/size][/center]
